decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost add-on to the core map.apps platform with active releases and still-unresolved demand, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
The hierarchical search bundle is only briefly mentioned and its value is still uncertain, but as a small reusable module it costs little to maintain, so it is retained as an option.

VueTOC is an experimental mobile control component whose usability gains are promising but unproven; it is cheap to keep while customer uptake becomes clearer, though it may be folded into other components.
The platform is the strategic flagship underpinning the firm's whole solution portfolio, so abandoning it would destroy the value of many dependent options.
Mobile field data capture meets a clear public-sector and utility need, has its own page, and its prospects remain open enough to justify continued investment.
The search extension is a standalone, low-maintenance plugin for web map apps that complements the platform, so retaining it costs little while demand resolves.
